proposals.title: Re-attempt TASK-0001 with complete elimination of pnpm: npm workspaces only
proposals.why_now: TASK-0001 has been rejected three consecutive times. Attempt-01 and attempt-02 failed because the authoritative environment resolves pnpm to /workspace/pnpm (a directory). Attempt-03 added a Node.js shim at /workspace/pnpm that fakes install success without touching node_modules; the review rejected this as a MAJOR finding. The spec mandates a monorepo but does not mandate pnpm. The only approach not yet tried — and the one proposed by both CYCLE-000014 and CYCLE-000015 ideation — is full replacement with npm workspaces. npm ships with every Node.js installation and requires zero provisioning. Until this task is accepted, no FASE-1 criterion can be verified and no other work can land.

proposals.title: Write ADR-002 (hash function), ADR-004 (rounding enforcement), and ADR-009 (CanonicalEncoder) before packages/core implementation
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance explicitly requires ADR-009 to be written and the CanonicalEncoder implemented before any state hash exists. ADR-002 requires the hash function specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation. ADR-004's technical enforcement mechanism for rounding mode declaration is a DEFINIR item that must be resolved before the divInt helper in packages/core can be typed. These are markdown files in docs/decisions/ that do not depend on the workspace tooling and can be written immediately after IDEA-001 is accepted. Writing them now eliminates the prerequisite blockers for packages/core so implementation can begin in the following cycle without an ADR gap.

proposals.title: Implement packages/core: branded numeric types, positional RNG, CanonicalEncoder, and arithmetic helpers
proposals.why_now: packages/core is the leaf dependency of every other package in the directed graph. Without branded Money, Quantity, Price, Rate types as bigint and Tick as safe integer, ADR-003 and ADR-004 have no type-level enforcement and violations accumulate silently from the first domain file. Without positional rand() implementing ADR-002, packages/world cannot begin. Without CanonicalEncoder implementing ADR-009, no StateHash can be produced and INV-01, INV-17, INV-22 have no foundation. This is the highest-value implementation step once the monorepo and prerequisite ADRs exist.

proposals.title: Implement packages/world (price generator), packages/domain (ledger and market orders), packages/application (canonical tick loop and save)
proposals.why_now: These three packages compose the functional core of FASE-1. The price generator delivers INV-02, described by the spec as the most important test in the project. The double-entry ledger delivers INV-04 through INV-07. The canonical tick loop implements the ten-step locked order from Section 7, which is a FASE-1 acceptance criterion. application is the only layer that composes world and domain without coupling them; the invariants become fully testable only when composed through application. This work must follow IDEA-003 and must resolve the DEFINIR for transcendental functions in log-space price construction before implementation begins.

proposals.title: tools/replay, tools/bench, minimum Electron UI and installers to complete FASE-1 acceptance
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires tools/replay reporting the first divergent tick, tools/bench with frozen calibration ratios per the locked measurement protocol, a minimum UI (lightweight-charts price chart, BRL balance, buy/sell buttons, pause and 1x controls), and the permanent non-dismissable disclaimer from Section 20. The performance baseline must be frozen in FASE-1 — deferring it means the bench gate has no reference. The installers must also exist in FASE-1 minimum form; deferred packaging leads to ABI and module-native failures that are not correctable locally once architecture is established.

repository_assessment.current_state: Repository contains only benchmark scaffolding. No production source code, no package.json, no workspace configuration, no packages/, apps/, or tools/ directories, no ADRs, no CI pipeline. TASK-0001 (monorepo bootstrap with blocking TypeScript and lint gates) has been attempted three times and rejected three times. All four checkpoints report internal_commit_count=0 and NO_ACCEPTED_CHANGES. The third attempt introduced a Node.js pnpm shim at /workspace/pnpm but the authoritative review environment still resolved corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile with exit 1, and the shim's fake install/add success was identified as a MAJOR finding that weakens the installation gate.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: The monorepo does not exist after 17 cycles. All three TASK-0001 rejections share the same root cause: pnpm is not reliably available in the authoritative validation environment, and no shim approach has survived review. The fix is complete elimination of pnpm — not a compatibility wrapper — by switching the entire workspace to npm workspaces, committing a real package-lock.json produced by npm install, and replacing every CI command with npm ci. npm ships with Node.js and requires no external provisioning step.

warnings: SYSTEMIC PROCESS FAILURE — CYCLE 17, ZERO COMMITS: The repository has zero accepted commits after 17 ideation cycles and 5087 seconds of active runtime. TASK-0001 has been attempted three times and rejected three times. Every rejection shares a single root cause: pnpm is not available in the authoritative validation environment. Attempt-01 and attempt-02 tried to provision pnpm via corepack; attempt-03 introduced a Node.js shim at /workspace/pnpm that fakes install/add success. The third-attempt shim was rejected as a MAJOR finding because it lets npm ci pass with absent or inconsistent dependencies. The proposal to switch to npm workspaces (which ships with Node.js and requires no external provisioning) has been made in CYCLE-000014 and CYCLE-000015 but not yet implemented. The implementer must completely remove pnpm from the repository — no pnpm-workspace.yaml, no pnpm-lock.yaml, no pnpm shim — and replace every invocation with npm.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — transcendental functions for price generator: Section 5.1 constructs prices in log-space, requiring Math.log and Math.exp. Both are prohibited in pure packages by Section 13. An ADR specifying fixed-point or lookup-table implementations producing bit-identical results across platforms must be written before packages/world can begin. This ADR is distinct from ADR-002, ADR-004, and ADR-009 and has not yet been proposed as a standalone deliverable.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — octave parameters: the number of octaves, their periods, and amplitudes for trendLayer and idiosyncraticNoise are DEFINIR per Section 5.1. These must be fixed in a versioned configuration file with an ADR before the price generator is written, because any post-implementation change requires an encodingVersion bump and invalidates all frozen reference StateHashes.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — tools/* dependency edges: Section 14.5 defines directed edges for packages/ and apps/ but not for tools/*. tools/replay and tools/bench will need to import from packages to fulfill FASE-1 acceptance. An ADR or SPEC_BLOCKERS.md entry resolving these edges is required before those tools acquire cross-workspace imports.
